xmldoc.short_description: Determine which timer handles are valid.

param_input_item.param_description: Timer object or timer object array.

param_output_item.param_description: Logical array with the same size as t. Values are true for valid timer handles and false for deleted timer handles.

description.p: isvalid checks whether timer handles still refer to live timer objects. Calling delete on a timer invalidates the handle.

example_item.example_item_description: Check a timer handle before and after deletion.
